title: Brazilian Vegan Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with vegan ingredients, inspired by Brazilian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Shattering
ingredients.notes: your choice of crispy fried onions or shallots

instructions: Heat Stir in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Fry to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add Brazilian tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add Shattering on top of the vegetables and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
